title: Palworld official Workshop package Info.json
description: Info.json for a Palworld first-party (Workshop) mod package, as deployed from Mods/Workshop/<folder>/. InstallRule entries name a Type — the install root inside the game directory (UE4SS -> Mods/NativeMods/UE4SS, Lua -> Mods/NativeMods/UE4SS/Mods/{PackageName}, PalSchema -> Mods/NativeMods/UE4SS/Mods/PalSchema/mods/{PackageName}, LogicMods -> Pal/Content/Paks/LogicMods, Paks -> Pal/Content/Paks/~WorkshopMods/{PackageName}) — and Targets, the package-relative paths copied there. Provenance: field list read off Pocketpair's own uploader source (github.com/pocketpairjp/PalworldModUploader Models/ModInfo.cs) and docs.palworldgame.com/settings-and-operation/mod, fetched 2026-10-05. The loader reads this file at game start and writes Mods/ManagedMods/<PackageName>/InstallManifest.json on restart.

PackageName.description: Identifier the loader keys everything on: ActiveModList in Mods/PalModSettings.ini matches this value (not the folder name), ManagedMods/<PackageName>/ is the manifest folder, and it is appended to the Lua/PalSchema/Paks install roots. Need not be unique across Workshop items — but if two enabled items share a PackageName only one is enabled, and the order is not guaranteed. The PalSchema core must use exactly "PalSchema".

Thumbnail.description: Workshop thumbnail path, relative to the package folder.

Version.description: Compared as a plain string against the installed copy: a different string triggers uninstall + reinstall on the next launch. Semantic versioning is not required.

DebugMode.description: true = uninstall and reinstall (recopy from the Workshop folder) on every launch, even when Version is unchanged.

MinRevision.description: Minimum game revision (build number) this package supports.

Dependencies.description: PackageNames this package requires; the uploader prompts for them at publish time.

InstallRules.description: Alias. The official key is "InstallRule" (singular, per the official uploader's own model); palschema-hub accepts this spelling with a warning.

Type.description: Selects the install root inside the game directory (see the table in the schema description).

IsServer.description: true = this rule applies to the dedicated server. A package with no IsServer:true rule will not run on a dedicated server.

Targets.description: Package-relative paths to deploy under the Type's root, e.g. "./Scripts". A ".." segment would deploy outside the game directory and is rejected by palschema-hub's check-package.
